long_biography.plain_text:
Highland Paving has remained an owner-run construction business under John McCauley, whose responsibilities span decisions about asphalt plants, site work and highway projects across southeastern North Carolina. He helps direct contracts for state roadwork while remaining involved in the firm's major decisions. Its operating reach extends beyond paving crews to the production of hot-mix asphalt for the jobs it undertakes.

McCauley came to construction after studying economics at Davidson College and law at the University of North Carolina. He worked first as a prosecutor and then in business litigation before establishing the paving firm in Fayetteville. Beyond construction, he was a founding director of Select Bank and Trust and later joined the board of First Bancorp after the bank's acquisition.

proposed_details.existing_value:
Per information retrieved from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) records, the yacht named Libertas is under the ownership of John McCauley, hailing from North Carolina, USA.

Mr. McCauley, a former legal professional with experience as a prosecutor and commercial litigator, currently holds the roles of Founder and CEO at Highland Paving Co LLC. This company specializes in offering site preparation and paving solutions to a range of clients including property proprietors, developers, contractors, and governmental bodies. Highland Paving manages several asphalt plants located in Fayetteville, Wilmington, and Southern Pines, NC, and has a workforce of over 220 individuals.

In addition to his involvement in the paving industry, Mr. McCauley is a key figure as a founding Director of Select Bank and Trust, a community-based financial institution. The year 2021 witnessed the acquisition of Select Bank and Trust by First Bancorp, and as a result, Mr. McCauley now occupies a position on the Board of Directors of First Bank.
